answer: A numbered marble milestone stands on a dawn market lane; its saffron stripe is the proof. At dawn the holder paints one saffron stripe across its carved notch and photographs it with the date. Two verifiers visit within 24 hours and match the stripe and the milestone number; a stripe never painted at dawn, or a duplicate number, locks the account and burns its deposit. One stripe is cheap; 100 fakes need 100 milestones and 100 dawn trips.
